description: Foreign-trained doctors typically face licensing examinations plus a residency place secured in competition with domestic graduates - commonly 3-7 years before independent practice.
Professional engineer designation requires credential assessment, examinations and supervised experience under a licensed engineer - which requires first getting hired without the designation.
Most people work outside their profession while re-qualifying. The income gap and skill decay during those years are the real cost, not the exam fees.
energy_note: Watching your profession recede while you drive to pay for the exam.

description: Maryam qualified in Tehran in 2019 and practised for four years. In Canada the pathway is an equivalency assessment, two written exams, a clinical exam and a qualifying year: roughly CAD 34,000 and three to five years. She drives for a delivery app in the evenings and studies in the afternoons.
energy_note: Your profession, visible through glass, for five years.
